**There are 7 continents:**

- Africa
- Antarctica
- Asia
- Europe
- North America
- South America
- Australia (often called Oceania in broader models)

This is the standard model taught in most of the world. Some systems use 6 (merging Europe and Asia into Eurasia, or combining North and South America) or even 5, but 7 remains the most common convention.
